pin.name: Hall of Heroes
pin.notes: The Hall of Heroes: the Kimrs' ancestral arcology at the Labyrinth's one eastern opening, standing in its reflecting pond on the Gowd Warra (r331), 1,131 m, Cfb. After Soleri's Arcvillage II: a hexagon 424 m across and 400 m high on six columns, two topographies, a skylight well; five carved stacks bridged to it. A ruin: the Kimr bury their dead in its broken cells and walk their funerals along its causeways (biomes/labyrinth/PLAN-GATE.md; kits/ancients targets/gatearc; the Labyrinth's station 1, the Gate).
